description: Sixteen latching buttons, one per channel of a single polyphonic output.

params.text: Latches its own channel of the output high or low.
Latches its own channel of the output high or low; this button is one of channels 13 to 16, despite the panel printing 12-16 over the group.

outputs.text: All sixteen channels at once, each at 0V or at the voltage named by the menu Range.

notes: The buttons are read once every 256 samples rather than on every one, so a change at the output can lag the press slightly.
menu: Invert Output — puts each channel's voltage out while its button is unlit and 0V while it is lit
Range: +5V, +10V — sets the voltage a switched-on channel carries
